news.titleEn: Stock market rocked as investors dump tech shares; Nasdaq suffers worst day since June: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: On Oct. 30 the Nasdaq fell 2.86% to 25,437, the S&P 500 slid 1.82% to 7,580 and the Dow lost 572 points as weak tech earnings revived fears about AI spending.
news.conclusionZh: 美股周五重挫，纳指跌2.86%创6月来最差单日
news.whyEn: It shows investors are losing patience with huge AI capex that has yet to pay off, pulling money out of chip and big-tech stocks that dominate global indexes.
news.whyZh: 市场开始质疑AI巨额投入的回报，科技权重股拖累全球指数
news.detailEn: Disappointing results and guidance from Alphabet, Amazon and Intel this week triggered the selloff, with AMD down about 11% and Nvidia and Broadcom falling 4% and 5%. Investors rotated into defensive names such as Walmart and Coca-Cola, which limited the Dow's losses. Selling picked up into month-end and ahead of the Nov. 3 US midterm elections. Next week brings Apple and AMD earnings plus the US jobs report, so volatility may stay high.
news.detailZh: 本周Alphabet、亚马逊和英特尔的财报与指引不及预期，引发抛售，AMD跌约11%，英伟达和博通分别跌4%和5%。资金转向沃尔玛、可口可乐等防御股，道指跌幅因此较小。月末叠加11月3日美国中期选举临近，尾盘抛压加大。下周还有苹果、AMD财报和非农数据，波动可能延续。

news.titleEn: Iran claims four tankers struck mines in Hormuz as strike fears grow after U.S. midterms
news.conclusionEn: Iran's IRGC said four tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz, three catching fire on an "unauthorized southern route" near Oman, as reports said the US may resume strikes after the midterms.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗称4艘油轮在霍尔木兹触雷，美方或在中期选举后再动武
news.whyEn: Hormuz normally carries about a fifth of global energy supply, so new mine attacks keep oil and fuel prices elevated and raise the risk of wider escalation.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹承载全球约五分之一能源供应，新袭击推高油价与升级风险
news.detailEn: UK Maritime Trade Operations confirmed a small boat attached explosives to one vessel, disabling it with an engine-room fire, and Oman rescued 25 crew from a burning tanker. Iran disputed US Central Command's claim that mines had been cleared. Houthis also claimed attacks on Saudi airports and oil facilities. Vice President JD Vance has proposed talks via Qatar, while reports say military options are being prepared for after Nov. 3.
news.detailZh: 英国海事贸易行动办公室证实，一艘小艇在油轮上安装爆炸物导致机舱起火，阿曼救出一艘燃烧油轮上的25名船员。伊朗质疑美军中央司令部「水雷已清除」的说法。胡塞武装同时声称袭击沙特机场和石油设施。美国副总统万斯提议经卡塔尔斡旋与伊朗谈判，但有报道称11月3日后军事选项已在准备中。

news.titleEn: Why bitcoin held up better after the record Binance hack
news.conclusionEn: Binance suffered a $6.3 billion hack, the largest crypto theft on record, which TRM Labs linked to North Korea; bitcoin fell about 4% to around $77,000.
news.conclusionZh: 币安遭63亿美元史上最大加密盗窃，比特币跌约4%
news.whyEn: It is about four times the previous record theft and shows even the biggest centralized exchange can be breached, renewing pressure for tighter custody rules.
news.whyZh: 规模约为此前纪录四倍，暴露中心化交易所托管风险，监管压力将加大
news.detailEn: Attackers drained wallets across about ten blockchains within roughly 20 minutes, and Binance said the breach may have started with a compromised engineer's laptop. Tether, Circle and others froze around $3 billion of the stolen funds, and Binance tapped its $1.2 billion user protection fund while suspending some withdrawals. Bitcoin's drop was milder than the average after past exchange hacks because the Bitcoin network itself was not compromised. Regulators and users will now watch whether Binance can fully cover client losses.
news.detailZh: 攻击者约20分钟内从约十条区块链上的钱包转走资产，币安初步调查称入侵可能源于一名工程师被攻破的笔记本电脑。Tether、Circle等机构已冻结约30亿美元被盗资金，币安动用12亿美元用户保护基金并暂停部分提币。由于比特币网络本身未被攻破，币价跌幅小于以往交易所被盗后的平均水平。接下来焦点是币安能否全额弥补用户损失。

news.titleEn: Intel stock has worst day since 1970s, wiping about $12 billion off government's stake
news.conclusionEn: Intel shares plunged 29% after weak guidance tied to a plant shutdown in Israel and a soft PC market, erasing about $12 billion from the US government's 10% stake.
news.conclusionZh: 英特尔暴跌29%，美国政府持股缩水约120亿美元
news.whyEn: Intel is central to US chip-manufacturing policy, and the government and Nvidia are both shareholders, so its troubles hit taxpayers and the semiconductor sector.
news.whyZh: 英特尔是美国芯片制造战略核心，政府与英伟达均持股，冲击整个半导体板块
news.detailEn: Intel guided to about $15-16 billion in revenue and 25 cents of adjusted EPS this quarter, well below the $17.1 billion and 43 cents analysts expected. It also warned of cash burn this year from heavy factory spending. Nvidia's stake in Intel lost about $6 billion in value. The plunge dragged chip stocks lower and deepened doubts about Intel's turnaround plan.
news.detailZh: 英特尔预计本季营收150亿至160亿美元、调整后每股收益25美分，远低于分析师预期的171亿美元和43美分，并警告今年因扩产投入将消耗现金。英伟达所持英特尔股份市值缩水约60亿美元。此次暴跌拖累芯片股整体下挫，也加深了市场对英特尔转型计划的怀疑。

news.titleEn: BOJ Holds Benchmark Rate Steady as Expected After September Hike
news.conclusionEn: The Bank of Japan kept its policy rate at 1.25% in an 8-1 vote and raised its inflation forecast, while Governor Ueda signaled further hikes, possibly in December.
news.conclusionZh: 日本央行按兵不动维持1.25%，植田暗示12月或加息
news.whyEn: A more hawkish BOJ supports the yen and could pull Japanese money home from global bond markets, affecting yields and carry trades worldwide.
news.whyZh: 日本央行转鹰支撑日元，可能引发日资回流、影响全球债市与套利交易
news.detailEn: The decision followed a hike in September and holds by the Fed and ECB this week. The BOJ said underlying inflation has reached its 2% goal and that it will keep raising rates, while watching currency moves, AI and the Middle East. The yen strengthened to about 157 per dollar. Some economists expect the policy rate to reach 2% by mid-2027.
news.detailZh: 日本央行9月刚加息，本周美联储和欧洲央行也都按兵不动。日本央行表示基础通胀已达2%目标，将继续加息，但会关注汇率、AI和中东局势的影响。日元走强至约157兑1美元。部分经济学家预计政策利率到2027年年中将升至2%。

news.titleEn: Chevron and Exxon hit all-time highs as refining profits soar in reaction to Iran and Ukraine wars
news.conclusionEn: Exxon earned $15.4 billion and Chevron $9.9 billion in Q3, both beating estimates on record refining margins, and both stocks touched all-time highs.
news.conclusionZh: 埃克森、雪佛龙炼油利润飙升，三季度业绩超预期股价创新高
news.whyEn: War-driven refinery outages have sent US diesel to $6.32 a gallon, up 70% in a year, enriching oil majors while squeezing consumers and transport costs.
news.whyZh: 战事致炼厂受损，美柴油价同比涨70%，油企大赚而消费者与运输成本承压
news.detailEn: Exxon's profit roughly doubled from a year earlier and Chevron's rose nearly 200%. Attacks on refineries in Russia and the Middle East created diesel shortages, pushing US Gulf Coast plants to full capacity. Chevron CEO Mike Wirth called the system "fairly fragile." Energy stocks served as a hedge as tech sold off.
news.detailZh: 埃克森利润同比约翻倍，雪佛龙增近200%。俄罗斯和中东炼厂遭袭造成柴油短缺，美国墨西哥湾炼厂满负荷运转。雪佛龙CEO沃斯称整个系统「相当脆弱」。在科技股暴跌时，能源股成为避险选择。

news.titleEn: Treasuries Head for Monthly Gain as Tech Giants Stumble
news.conclusionEn: US Treasury yields hit one-month lows as the tech selloff drove investors into government bonds, with the 10-year yield dipping toward 4.9%.
news.conclusionZh: 科技股暴跌推动避险，美债收益率跌至一个月低点
news.whyEn: Lower yields ease borrowing costs for mortgages and companies, but high oil prices still threaten to keep inflation and rates elevated.
news.whyZh: 收益率下行利好房贷和企业融资，但高油价仍可能令通胀和利率居高
news.detailEn: The rally began right after Amazon and Intel reported disappointing results on Thursday evening. The 10-year yield fell as low as about 4.89% in Asian trading, its lowest since Sept. 10, and the 2-year dropped to around 4.59%. The advance stalled in US hours as oil prices jumped. Treasuries were set for a monthly gain after the Fed held rates at 3.75%-4%.
news.detailZh: 周四盘后亚马逊和英特尔财报令人失望后，美债随即走强。10年期收益率亚洲时段一度跌至约4.89%，为9月10日以来最低；2年期降至约4.59%。美盘时段因油价上涨，涨势放缓。在美联储将利率维持在3.75%至4%之后，美债本月有望录得上涨。

news.titleEn: Apple Reclaims Top Spot as World's Most Valuable Company, Surpassing Nvidia
news.conclusionEn: Apple's market value of $5.03 trillion overtook Nvidia's $4.93 trillion as Nvidia fell 4.2% and Apple only 1.2% amid AI-spending worries.
news.conclusionZh: 苹果市值5.03万亿美元，反超英伟达重回全球第一
news.whyEn: Investors are treating Apple as a relative safe haven in big tech because it spends far less on AI infrastructure than its peers.
news.whyZh: 苹果AI基建投入较少，被资金视为科技股中的相对避险标的
news.detailEn: It is the first time Apple has passed Nvidia since briefly doing so in late July. The shift reflects a rotation away from companies most exposed to the AI buildout. Apple reports fiscal fourth-quarter results on Nov. 2, its first under new CEO John Ternus. Those results will test whether its premium valuation holds.
news.detailZh: 这是苹果自7月底短暂超越后首次再次反超英伟达，反映资金正撤离AI基建敞口最大的公司。苹果将于11月2日公布财年第四季度业绩，这也是新任CEO John Ternus上任后的首份财报，将检验其高估值能否站稳。

news.titleEn: Reddit stock plunges 29% after issuing weak outlook for its worst day ever
news.conclusionEn: Reddit shares fell 29.22%, their worst day since the 2024 IPO, after weak Q4 sales guidance and a sharp drop in referral traffic from Google.
news.conclusionZh: Reddit指引疲弱、谷歌导流下滑，股价暴跌29%创上市最差
news.whyEn: It shows how Google's AI Overviews are cutting traffic to websites, a risk for any business that depends on search for visitors.
news.whyZh: 谷歌AI摘要正在截流网站流量，依赖搜索获客的企业都面临风险
news.detailEn: Reddit guided Q4 sales to $1 billion-$1.03 billion, below the $1.05 billion analysts expected, even though Q3 revenue grew 53%. CEO Steve Huffman said search-referral traffic from Google "went down meaningfully." The company plans to test requiring logins to view content, a big shift from its open model. Several analysts downgraded the stock.
news.detailZh: Reddit预计四季度营收10亿至10.3亿美元，低于分析师预期的10.5亿美元，尽管三季度营收增长53%。CEO霍夫曼表示来自谷歌的搜索导流「明显下降」。公司计划测试登录后才能浏览内容，这是对其开放模式的重大调整。多家分析机构下调评级。

news.titleEn: Poland Moves Against Top Court in a Showdown With the Opposition
news.conclusionEn: Police entered Poland's Constitutional Tribunal late Friday as its president Bogdan Swieczkowski and his deputy were served with one-month suspensions.
news.conclusionZh: 波兰警方进入宪法法庭，院长及副院长被停职一个月
news.whyEn: The clash between Tusk's government and the opposition-aligned court deepens a rule-of-law crisis in a major EU economy and NATO frontline state.
news.whyZh: 图斯克政府与宪法法庭对立升级，加深欧盟大国的法治危机
news.detailEn: Prime Minister Donald Tusk's government says Swieczkowski is performing the role illegally. Earlier this week a new judge chosen by parliament was sworn in, and protesters clashed with police outside the court. Swieczkowski called the police action an attack on a state body. The dispute could draw in President Karol Nawrocki, who is aligned with the opposition.
news.detailZh: 图斯克政府称斯维奇科夫斯基任职不合法。本周早些时候议会选出的新法官宣誓就职，法院外抗议者与警方发生冲突。斯维奇科夫斯基称警方行动是对国家机构的攻击。争端可能进一步牵涉与反对派立场接近的总统纳夫罗茨基。

businessTips.explanationEn: The principle of least privilege means every person, system or app gets only the minimum access needed to do its job, and only for as long as needed. It limits how much damage one mistake, rogue insider or hacked account can cause. It applies beyond IT: signing authority, bank access and supplier logins should follow the same rule.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小权限原则指每个人、系统或应用只获得完成工作所需的最少权限，且只在需要时开放。它能限制单个失误、内部人员作恶或账号被盗造成的损失。这个原则不只适用于IT，签字权、银行账户权限和供应商后台登录也应遵循。
businessTips.exampleEn: Binance's record hack reportedly began with one engineer's compromised laptop that could submit withdrawals. In a small business, a cleaner or VA might need booking-system access but not payout settings; splitting those roles means one stolen password cannot drain the account.
businessTips.exampleZh: 据报道，币安的创纪录盗窃始于一名工程师被攻破的电脑，而它能直接提交提币指令。在小企业里，保洁或助理可能需要访问预订系统，但不需要改收款设置；把权限拆开，一个密码被盗也不至于让账户被掏空。

businessTips.explanationEn: Zero-click search is when people get their answer directly on the search results page, now often from an AI summary, and never click through to a website. It means traffic from Google is becoming less reliable for blogs, affiliate sites and small shops. Founders should build channels they own, like email lists, repeat customers and social communities.
businessTips.explanationZh: 零点击搜索指用户直接在搜索结果页（如今常是AI摘要）拿到答案，不再点进网站。这意味着博客、联盟营销网站和小网店来自谷歌的流量越来越不可靠。创业者应搭建自有渠道，如邮件列表、回头客和社群。
businessTips.exampleEn: Reddit's shares fell 29% partly because Google referral traffic dropped. A side-hustle recipe blog could respond by offering a free downloadable meal plan in exchange for emails, so readers can be reached even if search traffic falls.
businessTips.exampleZh: Reddit股价暴跌29%，部分原因就是谷歌导流下降。一个副业食谱博客可以用免费下载的一周菜单换取读者邮箱，这样即使搜索流量下降，也能直接触达读者。

businessTips.term: Custodial Risk (Not Your Keys, Not Your Coins)
businessTips.explanationEn: Custodial risk is the chance of losing assets because the institution holding them fails, is hacked or freezes withdrawals. With stocks, brokers usually keep client assets segregated and investor protection schemes may apply; with crypto on an exchange, you rely on the exchange's security and solvency. Spreading holdings and understanding who actually holds your assets reduces this risk.
businessTips.explanationZh: 托管风险指因托管机构倒闭、被黑或冻结提现而损失资产的可能。股票通常由券商隔离保管，部分地区还有投资者保护计划；而放在交易所的加密资产，安全与否取决于交易所自身的安全和偿付能力。分散存放并弄清资产到底由谁保管，能降低这类风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: After Binance's $6.3 billion hack, some withdrawals were suspended even though bitcoin itself was not hacked. An investor holding long-term crypto might keep only trading amounts on an exchange and move the rest to a self-custody hardware wallet, accepting the duty to safeguard their own keys.
businessTips.exampleZh: 币安被盗63亿美元后部分提币被暂停，尽管比特币网络本身并未被攻破。长期持有加密资产的投资者可以只在交易所留交易所需的部分，其余转入自托管硬件钱包，但同时要自己承担保管私钥的责任。
